obligations.expected_behavior: When a reconstruction mutation changes a bound input, the snapshot outcome is determined as either reproducible or stale.
forbidden_result: The changed-input snapshot is neither reproducible nor stale.
obligations.observable_result: The isolated reconstruction-mutation fixture shows that the snapshot is classified as reproducible or stale after the bound input change.
obligations.state_after: After reconstruction mutation of a bound input, the snapshot has a reproducible or stale outcome.
obligations.state_before: A snapshot exists with bound inputs before the reconstruction mutation.
obligations.subject: Snapshot handling for bound input changes
obligations.trigger: A reconstruction mutation changes a bound input.

obligations.expected_behavior: Verify the bound-input reconstruction outcome using an isolated reconstruction-mutation fixture while holding all other inputs constant.
forbidden_result: The verification changes or varies other inputs.
The outcome is inferred without the isolated reconstruction-mutation fixture.
obligations.observable_result: The verification record identifies the isolated reconstruction-mutation fixture and demonstrates that all other inputs were held constant while observing reproduce-or-stale behavior.
obligations.state_after: A controlled verification result exists for the reconstruction mutation with all non-target inputs held constant.
obligations.state_before: The reconstruction-mutation behavior has not yet been isolated and verified under constant non-target inputs.
obligations.subject: Controlled verification of reconstruction mutation
obligations.trigger: Verification is performed for the bound-input change scenario.
